_readme: Named, ordered paths through the prototype. The client steps through one with the arrow keys instead of clicking around. Each step names a screen id (slug, or slug/frameIndex) and says what the member is doing there. Screen ids that do not exist are skipped at runtime and counted in the picker, so a typo is visible rather than silent.

journeys.name: A member posts an idea and it reaches the threshold
journeys.why: The product's central promise: an idea with enough support becomes a proposal the club must vote on.

steps.note: The member opens the War Room. Ideas, Voting, Results and Actions each have a rail.
They tap the accent + to start an idea. The gate states what posting costs and what the rules are.
Compose. Title, body and category. The category decides which threshold the idea must clear.
Compliance and timing. The club's house rules are checked before the idea can post.
The deposit is locked. It returns in full unless the idea lapses.
Posted. This is the screen every member sees most often after acting.
The idea now sits in the Ideas list alongside everything else open.
The detail screen: who proposed it, the clock, and how close it is to the likes it needs.
Support builds. The gauge is a percentage of the threshold, not of the membership.

journeys.name: An idea runs out of time and lapses
journeys.why: The only case where a deposit is forfeited. Worth showing because it is the one downside a member carries.

steps.note: An open idea with the clock running.
Support has stalled well below the threshold.
The clock reaches zero and the idea lapses. This is the one case where the deposit does not come back.

journeys.name: A member votes on a proposal and it is approved
journeys.why: The decision moment. Everything before it is build-up.

steps.note: The Voting rail carries proposals that cleared the idea stage.
Everything currently open to a vote.
Before voting: the proposal, its options and the clock.
Casting the ballot.
Voted. The chart is locked so a member cannot be swayed by the running count.
Settled and approved. The club now owes an action.
The result, recorded.

journeys.name: A new member signs up and picks a club
journeys.why: First run. Note the shipped app cannot complete this in-app — see the contrasting journey below.

steps.note: Splash.
Get started.
Choose your pathway.
Your details. The date of birth field drives the age gate.
Your identity.
Choose the club you support.
Landed. The member is in.

journeys.name: What sign-up actually does today
journeys.why: The contrast with the journey above. The shipped app hands the member to the desktop site and stops.

steps.note: Get started, as shipped.
Tapping through to sign up opens a dialog telling the member to use the club's website. The journey ends in the app here.
